candidates.name: Reviewing agent output arriving faster than you can inspect it
candidates.description: It's a curse I know, parallel lanes, context switching. We're told to aim for surgical precision, one item at the time. But when the world is keeping endless inspiration, software commoditised it's hard to live by the rule. Running several agents at the same time, I found myself having a hard time catching up on everything produced, and giving proper feedback. I tend to actually ask my agent to go through transcripts to find old unfinished tasks and re-state the outputs.
